contents.text:
I don’t have an image yet. Please upload the image (or share a link to it) and I’ll help with both parts.

What I’ll do:
- Describe what’s visibly in the image (people, objects, scenery, colors, lighting, signs, etc.).
- Look for location clues (landmarks, language on signs, architecture, natural features) to suggest where it might have been taken.
- If the image has metadata (EXIF), I can try to read any date/time and coordinates if you’re comfortable sharing that.
- Give you my best guess with explanations and possible alternatives you can verify (e.g., by searching for a visible landmark).

If you can’t upload the image, you can also describe what you see and I’ll try to infer the location from your description.
